parameters.name: Members
parameters.description: The list of target user information.

sub_parameters.name: UserId
sub_parameters.description: The user ID of the user to be added. You can call the [ListUsers](~~141938~~) or [GetUser](~~147098~~) operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: ObjectId
parameters.description:
The object ID:

- Project workspace ID (Id). You can call the [GetLhSpaceByName](~~424379~~) operation to obtain this value.
- Task flow ID (Id). You can call the [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: ObjectType
parameters.description:
The object type. Valid values:
- **0**: project workspace
- **1**: task flow

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain this value.
